authorization: 2026-09-15: Confirm how many catchments meet the availability criteria.
purpose: coverage-only feasibility; no model predictions, scores, Q export or fitted statistics
candidate_list: Kratzert multiple_forcing 531_basin_list.txt, verified against local dPLHBV list
primary_fraction_rationale: Study-specific pragmatic coverage floor, not a literature standard. Retain at least four-fifths of each period, without requiring perfect records.
climate_rules: P statistics use valid P; T uses finite non-sentinel ordered Tmin/Tmax; cold-precipitation uses their intersection; reject zero precipitation total. Coverage by actual required variables.
dynamic_rules: Keep original values; reject nonfinite, negative P/srad/vp, temperature sentinel, Tmax<Tmin; skip affected 365-day windows. No interpolation or swapping.
q_rules: Only 1989-10-01..2008-09-30 values parsed. Missing M/negative/nonfinite invalid; zero valid; A and P qualifiers accepted as pilot; unknown flag requires review. No imputation. NSE-definedness boolean only.
static_rules: Use existing 16 land fields. geol_porosity missing allowed with train-only median and indicator later; other missing/invalid numeric values require review.
area_rules: Use published 531 membership; finite positive forcing-header area for conversion; other area differences reported, not automatic additional exclusions.
primary_pool: Meets all three period requirements, permitting subsequent role assignment. Role-specific eligibility also reported; unsuitable for primary pool does not mean unusable for every study.
pilot: No changes to current pilot configuration, splits, models or results. Pilot test Q is included in this explicitly authorized quality-only access and must not be described as never read afterward.
